title: A new website for the Division
summary: iahrapd.org has been rebuilt around the Division's own records — the full congress archive, the By-Laws, award citations and the annual reports to the IAHR Council.
body:
The Division's website has been rebuilt. Alongside the news and congress pages, the following are now published in full for the first time:

- the [By-Laws of IAHR-APD](/documents/by-laws/), readable on the site, with the superseded 2004 edition kept alongside
- the statements and rules of the [three APD awards](/awards/)
- the Division's [annual reports to the IAHR Council](/governance/#reports)
- the [congress archive](/congresses/) from the 1st congress to the 26th
- a [photographic record](/gallery/) of congresses and committee meetings

Members who can fill any of the remaining gaps — particularly the years and themes of the first five congresses, and photographs from the 19th to 24th congresses — are asked to write to the Secretariat.
